scope: Development-only remerge-to-master coarse affine registration; retain failure, no reading benchmark.
prior_exposure: Both textures/master and prior merge5 failure known. Remerge chosen from six-texture triage. New correspondence outcomes not yet inspected.

algorithm.read: IMREAD_GRAYSCALE, source bytes immutable; arrays only
algorithm.matching: L2 forward ratio strict threshold and mutual best
algorithm.geometric_dedup: Sort ascending descriptor distance, second distance, texture y,x, master y,x; greedily retain only pairs with neither native texture nor master floor(x),floor(y) pixel-bin previously retained. Preserve every rejected pair.
algorithm.partition: 256-native-texture-pixel tiles; validation iff (tile_x+2*tile_y)%3==2. All retained pairs in a tile share a partition. No fit on validation.
algorithm.fit: estimateAffine2D RANSAC, original coordinates, fitting pairs only

limits: Spatial holdout and dedup reduce leakage; still correlated image features, not independent reading labels.
Affine may fail on warped composite. No retuning to force pass.
All 68 prior mapping points projected only if finite fit; none becomes an accepted verse/letter locator.
No-finite-fit is recorded as failed outcome, not discarded run.
